title: Longest Chunked Palindrome Decomposition
summary: Given a string text, divide it into k substrings such that each substring is non-empty, the concatenation of all substrings equals text, and the first and last substrings are identical, as are the second and second-to-last, and so on.
statement: Given a string text, divide it into k substrings such that each substring is non-empty, the concatenation of all substrings equals text, and the first and last substrings are identical, as are the second and second-to-last, and so on. The goal is to maximize the value of k.
constraints: Mirrored chunks must be equal; maximize their count.
hints: Grow equal-length pieces inward from both ends.
Whenever the accumulated prefix and suffix match, commit them immediately.
Count two chunks unless both pieces are the same central character, then reset accumulators.
Choosing the earliest outer match cannot reduce future chunks and maximizes the remaining interior.
editorial: Choosing the earliest outer match cannot reduce future chunks and maximizes the remaining interior.

tests.explanation: The symmetric pieces split into seven chunks.
No matching outer pieces exist, so the whole text is one chunk.
